description: This file defines and implements functions related to WiFi events, including event creation, cloning, destruction, string conversion, priority handling, and queue management within a WiFi control context. It handles various WiFi event types and subtypes, manages memory allocation and copying of event data, and supports event queuing for processing by other components.

methods.name: const char * wifi_event_type_to_string(wifi_event_type_t type)
methods.description: Converts a WiFi event type enum to its string representation for logging or debugging.

methods.name: const char * wifi_event_subtype_to_string(wifi_event_subtype_t type)
methods.description: Converts a WiFi event subtype enum to a string for identification or debugging.

methods.name: bool is_high_priority_event(wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type)
methods.description: Determines if a given event subtype is considered high priority, influencing queue handling.

methods.name: int clone_wifi_event(wifi_event_t * event,wifi_event_t ** clone)
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a WiFi event, handling different event types and allocating necessary memory.

methods.name: wifi_event_t * create_wifi_event(unsigned int msg_len,wifi_event_type_t type,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new WiFi event structure for given message length, type, and subtype.

methods.name: wifi_event_t * create_wifi_monitor_response_event(const void * msg,unsigned int msg_len,wifi_event_type_t type,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type)
methods.description: Creates a WiFi event specifically for handling monitor responses, including associated response data.

methods.name: void destroy_wifi_event(wifi_event_t * event)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a WiFi event, including nested data depending on event type.

methods.name: int copy_msg_to_event(const void * data,unsigned int msg_len,wifi_event_type_t type,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,wifi_event_route_t * rt,wifi_event_t * event)
methods.description: Copies raw message data into a WiFi event structure, handling different event types and ensuring correct memory copying.

methods.name: int push_monitor_response_event_to_ctrl_queue(const void * msg,unsigned int len,wifi_event_type_t type,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,wifi_event_route_t * rt)
methods.description: Creates a monitor response event and pushes it onto the control queue if within size limits or if high priority.

methods.name: int push_event_to_ctrl_queue(const void * msg,unsigned int len,wifi_event_type_t type,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,wifi_event_route_t * rt)
methods.description: Creates a WiFi event from raw message data and enqueues it onto the control queue, respecting size limits and priority.

methods.name: int push_event_to_monitor_queue(wifi_monitor_data_t * mon_data,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,wifi_event_route_t * rt)
methods.description: Wraps monitor data into an event and queues it into the monitor-specific queue with priority considerations.

methods.name: void events_update_clientdiagdata(unsigned int num_devs,int vap_idx,wifi_associated_dev3_t * dev_array)
methods.description: Updates client diagnostic information with current associated device data, formatted into JSON.
